instruction: Look at `blank.sch`, add a landscape `DINA4_L` frame from the `frames` library, and populate its title block using the values provided in `/home/user/Desktop/info.txt`. Save the result as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.sch`. Requirements: 1. The file must parse as EAGLE XML. 2. At least one `<part>` must use library `frames` and deviceset `DINA4_L`. 3. That frame part must also be placed on the sheet via an `<instance>`. 4. The strings `My Title`, `John Doe`, `2026`, and `v1.0` must appear in the schematic. 5. The sheet must contain at least 4 visible `<text>` elements.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(15); pyautogui.hotkey('shift', 'tab'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('enter')
